Found real footer link 'Partner Program' -> https://www.fathom.ai/partner-programs

Fathom does NOT have a simple self-serve content-affiliate program. It offers 4 distinct partner tracks: (1) Solution/Growth Partners - commission-based, for agencies/consultants/service providers, application-reviewed; (2) Integration & tech partners - for API integration builders; (3) Points program - in-product referral rewards (not real commission, requires being an existing paying-ish user); (4) Qualified Portfolio Partners - for VC firms/accelerators.

Clicked into 'Solution Partners' -> https://www.fathom.ai/program/growth-partner ('Fathom Growth Partner Program | For Agencies & Consultants') - explicitly requires (a) an ACTIVE Fathom user account first, and (b) submission of a manually-reviewed partner intake form (48hr review, business email required)
Clicked APPLY -> opened new tab: PartnerStack-hosted application form at https://dash.partnerstack.com/application?company=fathom&group=growthpartnertier2&gref=page

PartnerStack pre-filled our existing account's Email/First name/Last name automatically, confirming an existing PartnerStack relationship was found and reused (per standing instructions) rather than creating a new one

Scrolling the PartnerStack form revealed it is heavily oriented toward HubSpot solution-partner agencies specifically: it includes REQUIRED fields 'Are you a HubSpot Partner?', 'What is your HubSpot partner tier?', and 'Include a link to your HubSpot listing page.' - none of which COSHUMA (an AI/SaaS directory/content site, not a HubSpot implementation partner) can honestly complete

result.important_followup_note: Fathom has no simple self-serve content-affiliate signup. The only commission-bearing track ('Growth Partner Program') is explicitly designed for agencies/consultants/HubSpot implementation partners and requires (1) an active Fathom user account, (2) a manually-reviewed intake form with REQUIRED HubSpot-partner-tier and HubSpot-listing-page fields that a directory/content site like COSHUMA cannot honestly satisfy, and (3) up to 48hrs of manual review by Fathom's team. An alternative lighter-weight option exists: the in-product 'Points program' (earn points/rewards via referral link, redeemable for perks, top referrers can eventually be invited into the Growth Partner track) - but this requires first creating and using a regular Fathom account, which was left undone per the no-account-creation-without-review policy. Recommend 큰형 decide between: (a) proceeding with the Growth Partner PartnerStack form by honestly answering 'No' to HubSpot Partner and accepting the application may be rejected/deprioritized, or (b) creating a personal Fathom account and pursuing the simpler Points program referral link instead, or (c) skipping Fathom's affiliate program entirely as not well-suited to a directory site.
